answer: The GAO AI Accountability Framework recommends that entities document the sources and origins of data used to develop AI models. This includes providing documentation on how data have been collected, prepared, labeled, and maintained to ensure data quality and enable third-party assessments. Additionally, entities should assess the reliability of the data used to develop the models, ensuring that the data are accurate, complete, and valid, and that they represent the constituent populations served by the AI system. Corrective actions should be taken to enhance the quality, accuracy, reliability, and representativeness of the data.
